title: Puzzle 3d Ctrl A Select All
description: Implement ctrl+a (and meta+a on mac) to select all objects, vortices, and attractions in puzzle 3d play, respecting selectable/visible kind toggles.
summary: Added selectAllSelection command and puzzle3dPlayAllSelectionFromFixture helper so Ctrl/Cmd+A selects every object, vortex, and attraction in the fixture, respecting selectable and visible kind toggles. Registered ctrl+a,meta+a on Playground3d keybindings and wired declarative playground keybindings through PlaygroundView so shortcuts dispatch to the command bus. Tests cover fixture snapshot building and controller select-all behavior.
